modules.heading: Content has evolved. Your tools should too.
modules.subheading: Publishing regularly is no longer enough. Algorithms weigh consistency, topical relevance and how people behave. PRIZMA builds the formats you need from a single topic, each one tuned to its channel.

items.name: Post
items.desc: A post that shows what your company can do. Not just an image, but a statement that stays in the feed and builds trust.

items.name: Reel
items.desc: Short-form video with a clear message. Algorithms distribute it organically. The most direct route to new reach, with no ad budget.

items.name: Carousel
items.desc: Complex ideas, broken down clearly. Carousels earn saves and shares. The kind of content people bookmark and come back to.

items.name: Story
items.desc: Short, current and casual. Stories keep your channels alive between the bigger posts, and they are what people see first.

items.name: Article
items.desc: An article that keeps bringing visitors for years. PRIZMA looks at real search queries and builds the text so it lands near the top.

items.name: Avatar
items.desc: A face for your brand, with no camera and no shoot. The AI avatar delivers your script on video, regularly and at consistent quality.

why.heading: Not a text generator. A system that runs your channels.
why.text: Most tools produce text and stop there, which leaves the work with you. PRIZMA takes on the whole chain: it turns your topics into the right formats, aims them at real search queries and your region, publishes them on your channels and learns from what works. Every text is tuned to the way your company speaks, with no robotic tone and no filler. The final call is always yours.

items.desc: Products get content that sells and gets found in search.

items.title: Hotels and hospitality
items.desc: A steady presence on every channel while the team stays with the guest.

items.title: Schools and kindergartens

items.title: Manufacturing and trade

items.title: Agencies and resellers
items.desc: Several client brands from one system, each with its own voice.

trust.heading: What German companies ask about first
trust.lead: PRIZMA works with what your business already has: products, offers, dates and news. It needs no access to your customer records.

items.title: Provider and servers in the EU
items.desc: Your contracting party is based in Bielefeld and the servers sit inside the EU. Contract, invoice and your contact person are all in Germany.

items.title: Data processing agreement included
items.desc: If your data protection people need an agreement under Art. 28 GDPR, you get one from us, written for your project. Your legal team has everything it needs.

items.title: You decide where your texts are written
items.desc: Normally we take care of everything. If your internal rules ask for more, we work with a European provider or set the system up on a server of your own.

items.title: Nothing goes out without your approval
items.desc: You decide what is published automatically and what you want to see first. Your content is not used to train AI models without your consent.
